title: Live ids and bulk export
issue_title: Live ids and bulk vector export
change_summary: List active row ids, read decoded float32 vectors in bulk, or stream live rows to NDJSON without looping get() on every id.
bindings_note: C API logosdb_live_ids, Python live_ids(), Node liveIds(), rawVectors(), and exportNdjson().
tagline: Embedded vector DB for AI agents and RAG
release_tagline: Scan live rows in one call instead of one get() per id

highlights.name: liveIds()
highlights.desc: Ids of rows that are still in the index. Deleted rows are left out.

highlights.name: rawVectors()
highlights.desc: Every stored vector as float32, including float16 and int8 databases.

highlights.name: exportNdjson()
highlights.desc: Writes live rows to a file, one JSON object per line.

install: pip install logosdb   ·   npm i logosdb
